UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated operator profile and cryptographic signing identity metadata.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator owning this profile.

email.description: Verified email address of the operator.

operatorId.description: Badge or operator ID string (e.g., OP-4821).

name.description: Full name and rank of the operator.

unit.description: Assigned forensic or law enforcement unit/station.

keyFingerprint.description: 64-hex SHA-256 fingerprint of the operator's ECDSA P-256 public key.

publicKeyJwkJson.description: Serialized JSON Web Key (JWK) of the operator's ECDSA P-256 public key.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the operator profile was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the operator profile was last updated.

EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord
EvidenceRecord.description: Cloud-synced tamper-evident colorimetric field drug-test evidence record.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator who synced this record.

previousRecordHash.description: 64-hex SHA-256 hash of the preceding record in the chain.

imageSha256.description: 64-hex SHA-256 hash of the original untouched camera image bytes.

keyFingerprint.description: 64-hex SHA-256 fingerprint of the signing public key.

recordJson.description: Canonical JSON string of the complete SignedTestRecord (excluding binary Blobs).

capturedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the field capture occurred.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the record was synced.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated operator profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/records/{recordId}.description: Append-only cloud-synced signed field-test evidence records.
